states.changed: A visitor meets one log ruled for every receiver of word of a harm: four at sea, the Field's 19 AI receivers in laws and codes, and this house's practice and architect; rules the column the sea keeps, 'if not, why', and finds it empty in 22 of 25 rows; shows the 11 public bodies only, none of which must answer the sender; opens every cell on its passage; walks the night of 14 to 15 April 1912 on the Californian, the word reaching her Master four times, under today's rule; reads this house's relay as a log of 567 handoffs, 564 answered; and reads answering set against being answerable.

A visitor meets a new section, the word in 2026 entered as a log: eighteen entries of the two cases of step 6, 26 May to 16 November, in three lanes (the maker, those outside, public bodies), each opening on its passages; a button that rules it by the sea's regulation, showing the three words received with nothing on record and that each of the eight reasons for not acting was written 25 to 123 days after the word; a table that sets those reasons beside the Californian's 'Are they Company's signals?' and the reason SOLAS asks for; and, in section V, the attorneys general who made the maker answer, from 3 August to the suit of 16 November, under laws older than any rule on AI.

A visitor meets, at the head of the page, what the check found: sixteen claims read again against their sources, one withdrawn (the public bodies are answerable after all, by an ombudsman, a writ and a legislature, as the maker is by older law), ten corrected and three added, each with the passage it rests on; section V now sets the sea against itself like with like and defines an answer as a position taken, which a portal's receipt is not; section III shows what asked for each of the eight reasons (none a rule of receipt), moves a spokesperson's statement to its true date, and names who answers on the record, a company and a hundred unknown names; on a phone the wide figures say they scroll and the reasons stack.

A visitor now meets, at the head of the page, what the presentation changed, and in section I lays the two cases of step 6 over the log: the doors of the receivers the word had to be passed to light up, the cells of the receivers' own duties are ringed, and a table sorts the 20 duties the Field's check 96 says the two cases could set off by whose duty they are, each with what the record shows (none met; the one duty owed back to a sender, a firm's monthly word to the employee who reported, unknowable in both cases); the Paris Call's 'pass on' is struck as the Field's blind recoding moved it; section III reads the acts as 74, recounted, and one of the eight reasons as naming a circumstance too; section V ends on 'the cases test the door, not the log', and the check of 27 November stands after it.
